chunks: And in the narration of al-Bazanti, from al-Ridha عليه السلام, he said:
"Tafath is the clipping of the nails, the removal of dirt, and the removal of the ihram from oneself."

key_terms.التَّفَثُ: The state-removing acts of grooming performed after pilgrimage rites
key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: The pilgrim state or its garment
key_terms.الْوَسَخِ: Dirt or unclean matter on the body

ai.seo_question: What does tafath mean in hajj according to Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith defines tafath in the context of hajj as acts of personal grooming and release from the state of ihram. It clarifies that tafath includes trimming the nails, removing dirt, and putting off the ihram garments.
